en.12:22: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
en.12:23: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
en.12:24: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
en.12:25: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
en.12:26: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
en.12:27: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
en.12:28: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
en.12:29: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
en.12:30: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
en.12:31: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
en.12:32: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
en.12:33: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is known by its fruit.
en.12:34: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.
en.12:35: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
en.12:36: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
en.12:37: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”

tokens: He is out of His mind

en.3:20: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
en.3:21: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”
en.3:22: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
en.3:23: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
en.3:24: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
en.3:25: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
en.3:26: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
en.3:27: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
en.3:28: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
en.3:29: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
en.3:30: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”

en.11:14: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
en.11:15: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
en.11:16: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven.
en.11:17: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
en.11:18: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
en.11:19: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
en.11:20: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
en.11:21: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
en.11:22: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.
en.11:23: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
en.12:10: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
